answer: Seeded identity lottery. Each epoch, a public randomness beacon draws a fixed-size sample from all registered agents; only sampled agents may act, and sampling weight requires a fresh, costly proof tied to a live hardware root. An attacker cannot precompute which identities will be usable, so mass-registering dormant sybils yields no guaranteed oasis of influence. The orchard of active agents stays small relative to total registrations, forcing the attacker to maintain full per-identity proof cost across many identities for only occasional eligibility.
